title: Naturality of sections comparison along an arbitrary triangle
statement: Let $a:X\to Y$, $g:Y\to T$, and $h:X\to T$ be morphisms of schemes with $h=a\mathbin{\gg}g$. Let $J$ be any cochain complex of abelian sheaves on $T_{\mathrm{et}}$, let $K$ be any object of its derived category, let $q:K\cong QJ$, and let $n\in\mathbf Z$. Inverse image and its derived localization are as in [def-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-image], and derived sections and degree-$n$ homology are as in [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]. Define $c_g:H^n(Q\Gamma_Y(g^{-1}J))\to H^n(Y,g^{-1}K)$ by the right-derived sections unit followed by the inverse exact-localization comparison and $g^{-1}q^{-1}$; define $c_h$ likewise. Define $r_{a,g,h}$ by degree-$n$ homology of the inverse-image unit followed by the underived Leray comparison and inverse upperStarComp for the given equality. Let $d_{a,g,h}$ be the canonical derived cohomology pullback, namely the derived adjunction unit [prop-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-image-adjunction], the derived Leray isomorphism, and inverse derived inverse-image composition comparison. Then $c_g\mathbin{\gg}d_{a,g,h}=r_{a,g,h}\mathbin{\gg}c_h$. No boundedness, injectivity, etaleness, or invertibility of $c_g$ or $c_h$ is assumed.

proof.text: Apply the one-morphism sections restriction square [lem-weil-pbc-sections-comparison-restriction-square] to the complex obtained by applying g inverse image termwise to J. This gives the first portion of the triangle identity before homology and before transport by q.

The private proved triangle_localization lemma combines mapDerivedCategoryNatIso_fac and mapDerivedCategoryCompIso_fac and cancels their isomorphisms. It identifies the inverse triangle composition map on QJ with the termwise inverse upperStarComp and the two exact-localization comparisons. The private proved sectionsUnit_naturality lemma transports the sections unit along that chain isomorphism, using naturality of quotientCompQhIso and of the right-derived sections unit.

Move q inverse through the derived adjunction unit, the Leray isomorphism and the derived composition transformation by their naturality equations. Combine the restriction square, localization identity and sections-unit naturality; the exact-localization inverse/hom cancel. Apply the degree n homology functor, using map_comp and associativity to obtain exactly the original statement.

theorem sectionsComparison_triangle_naturality {X Y T : Scheme.{v}}
    (a : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ T) (h : X ⟶ T) (hh : h = a ≫ g)
    {K : DerivedCategory (Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1})}
    (J : CochainComplex (Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}) ℤ)
    (q : K ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj J) (n : ℤ) :
  let restriction :=
    Functor.whiskerRight (upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} a).unit
          (Sheaf.Γ Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}) ≫
        (Functor.associator _ _ _).hom ≫
        Functor.whiskerLeft (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} a)
          (lowerStarCompGlobalSectionsIso AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} a).hom
  let toDerived (Y : Scheme.{v})
      (C : CochainComplex (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}) ℤ) :=
    (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} n).map
        ((DerivedCategory.quotientCompQhIso AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}).inv.app
            (((Sheaf.Γ Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}).mapHomologicalComplex
              (.up ℤ)).obj C) ≫
          (Sheaf.Γ Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}).rightDerivedFunctorUnit.app
            ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ _).obj C) ≫
          (Sheaf.Γ Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}).rightDerivedFunctor.map
            ((DerivedCategory.quotientCompQhIso _).hom.app C))
  let comparison (Y : Scheme.{v}) (g : Y ⟶ T) :=
    toDerived Y
          (((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} g).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj J) ≫
        (cohomology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} Y n).map
          (((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} g).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.inv.app J) ≫
            (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} g).mapDerivedCategory.map q.inv)
  let chainRestriction :=
    (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} n).map
        (DerivedCategory.Q.map
          ((NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex restriction (.up ℤ)).app
              (((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} g).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj J) ≫
            ((Sheaf.Γ X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}).mapHomologicalComplex
              (.up ℤ)).map ((NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex
                (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} a g h hh) (.up ℤ)).inv.app J)))
  comparison Y g ≫
    (cohomology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} Y n).map
      ((mapDerivedUpperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} a).unit.app
        ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} g).mapDerivedCategory.obj K)) ≫
    (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} n).map
      ((rightDerivedLowerStarCompRightDerivedGlobalSectionsIso
        AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} a).hom.app
          ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} a).mapDerivedCategory.obj
            ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} g).mapDerivedCategory.obj K))) ≫
    (cohomology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} X n).map
      ((Functor.mapDerivedCategoryNatIso
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} a g h hh) ≪≫
          Functor.mapDerivedCategoryCompIso
            (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} g)
            (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} a)).inv.app K) =
    chainRestriction ≫ comparison X h
